ADVANCE PLUMBING SUPPLY OF WALLED LAKE INC
Data Entry Specialist - eCommerce
2035 Easy Street, Commerce, MI 48390
$18 - $25 an hour

About Us:

Welcome to Advance Plumbing & Heating Supply Company, a fourth-generation family owned and operated business, started in 1920. The company's original location was at 2984 Grand River Ave. in Detroit, across from the Motor City Casino. On October 31st, 2016 we moved to our new location at 150 Parsons St. in Midtown Detroit. The new state-of-the-art location features the City of Detroit's first ever Decorative Plumbing Showroom which opened in winter of 2018.

In 1990, with a solid reputation for excellence and an expanding market, Advance opened up a second location in Walled Lake, Michigan which features a state-of-the-art 5,000-square foot decorative plumbing showroom and an outstanding plumbing & heating parts counter.

Requirements:

What You'll Do:

As our eCommerce Data Entry Specialist, you will enter, update and verify data to ensure the smooth operation of our ecommerce sites.

Some Duties May Include:

Take data from multiple sources and combine to create product pages within an Excel template with a strong attention to detail
Manage product listing requirements from multiple channels including Walmart, eBay, and more.
Fully understand data flow between systems and troubleshoot when something isn't working correctly
Maintain product data template and identify opportunities to improve product listing and online visibility
Work with merchandising and marketing to enhance online product pages with better content

What You Need to Get the Job Done:

Excellent Microsoft Excel proficiency including knowledge of Power Query, Power BI, pivot tables, and mass data manipulation using Excel's native functions.
Experience with Channel Advisor/Rithum, Shopify, Unilog and BigCommerce are highly preferred
Experience in e-commerce operations, marketplace management, product data, inventory, pricing, or a related field
Familiarity with plumbing, home improvement, or construction fields would make you a winning candidate
Excellent communication skills
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data from various sources

What Will Make Us Really Love You:

A self-motivated, positive, team player eager to join the family
Excellent organization skills with the ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
Exceptional customer service skills

What You'll Love About Us:

A family-oriented business is kind of our tradition - for 100 years and counting!
We are Rebuilding Detroit, both through the physical buildings and the people who call it home. Regardless of your position, we hope that more people can find meaningful careers in Detroit's construction industries.
Come grow with us! Have the ability to learn skills or knowledge from educational and learning opportunities.
